purpose: GoHighLevel CRM, Workflows v3, Voice/Conversation AI, Custom Objects, and 5-layer agency backend governance CLI with preview-first mutations, API readback, and a source-cited knowledge vault.

discovery.setup: Python 3.11+. Offline doctor and governance audits (rebilling-audit, scope-audit, smtp-audit, dashboard-audit) need no credentials. Live 5-layer agency audits and remediation (live-audit, agency-locations, location-unnerf, agency-users, user-inspect, user-unnerf, user-sync-locations, dashboard-permissions, unlock-dashboards, smtp-status, smtp-unlock, rebilling-status, rebilling-sync, pit-list, email-domains) use GHL_TOKEN_ID or remote worker_ssh via ~/.config/legends-gohighlevel/agency.json. Live sub-account CRM, Workflows v3, Voice/Conversation AI, and Custom Objects operations require GHL_PIT (or GHL_ACCESS_TOKEN) and GHL_LOCATION_ID, or named profiles in ~/.config/legends-gohighlevel/config.json.
discovery.not_for: Ambient HighLevel/LeadConnector MCP servers, unconfirmed bulk CRM mutations, or storing tokens on command-line arguments.
examples: Run a live 5-layer permission, dashboard RBAC, SMTP, and rebilling audit across my GoHighLevel agency
Audit my GoHighLevel sub-account health, business profile, pipelines, and published workflows
Un-nerf location feature flags, user V2 scopes, Default Dashboards, and 1.05x rebilling across all HighLevel sub-accounts
Inspect a HighLevel user's V1 permissions, V2 scopes, Only Assigned Data flags, and +hubpro alias locations
Inspect my GoHighLevel pipelines, calendars, Workflows v3 definitions, Voice AI agents, and Custom Objects
Preview and update a GoHighLevel contact, tag, opportunity, custom value, or workflow status with readback verification
Audit HighLevel sub-account rebilling markups across all 14 metered SaaS Billing v2 products

scope: Portable Python 3.11+ CLI for HighLevel API v2 and Workflows v3 sub-account inspection and preview-first CRM mutations (contacts, tags, notes, opportunities, custom values, workflows, Voice AI, Conversation AI, Custom Objects, Funnels), live internal backend 5-layer agency governance (location flags, user V1/V2 scopes, Default Dashboard RBAC, Custom SMTP locks, 4-store + 14-product 1.05x rebilling sync), and an attachable legends-empire knowledge pack.
